status: Legacy caps, Load key and packed alpha compatibility implemented; overall applicable Wine remains incomplete.

dependencies.scope: Project-owned shipping and diagnostic preprocessing dependencies plus runtime compilation units and build/resource definitions; SDK/toolchain are recorded by version, not included in this project-source closure.

platformIsolation.scope: Same accepted isolated CPU/PCI/VGA/Wasm as prior batch;18 current host project modules frozen/copied before the cohort, including previous shared NV additions. This does not certify concurrent newer main-checkout CPU/NV work.

changes: D3D3 RGB EnumDevices includes the LINECAPS flag and omits obsolete input sorting requirements. D3D1/2 profiles retain their previous sorting and flags; all descriptor sizes, inventories, bounded copies and FindDevice assertions remain.

Device7 Load copies present keys and clears destination keys absent from the source. Legacy Texture1/2 Load retains absent keys and copies source-blit key only. Actual public setter/getter matrix covers512 source/destination masks and API policy combinations, canonical description bits and private last values, immutable source and existing failure prefixes.

Packed X1R5G5B5-to-A1R5G5B5 blits into system memory preserve the packed high bit through the existing software-memory path, including video sources with required real dirty readback. Video destinations retain ordinary opaque GPU format conversion. Ordinary same-format rules, clippers, keyed/depth/YUV/compressed refusals and copy ordering remain.

Targeted XP alpha probe independently checks32 packed words then32 actual GPU ARGB pixels across allfour source/destination pool combinations. Existing42 graph and57 metadata probes rerun with one exact final DLL; no simulated GPU replies or native-certificate claims.

Native system-DDraw original window-mode groups and separate indexed-empty state observations are diagnostics only. All original hard/flaky/skip records retained; these observations do not automatically waive proxy assertions.

comparison.scope: All original observed descriptor fields and HRESULTs match the final app-local DLL. Acknowledged metadata only, no pixel certificate.
Real GPU readback; includes root and implicit layout detach, peer preservation, cube faces, pointer-only replacements and duplicate aliases. Targeted evidence only.

source.scope: Targeted 42 graph pixel observations through app-local DLL, actual XP and GPU; no full Wine or independent native certificate.

graphPixelProbe.scope: Targeted app-local DLL evidence with actual GPU, independent patterned pixel oracle and captured command stream, not an independent native Windows certificate.
